rank_selection_rationale: rank 32 chosen from predictive_vs_causal_subspace_v2: tracking=5/8, pca=6/8, learned_causal=6/8, gradient_coordinate=5/8, projection of v_full=0/8 for every basis at every rank -- the sweet spot where several structured bases succeed under fresh optimization without one basis dominating (unlike rank 64, where gradient_coordinate reaches 8/8 and would distort the comparison).
position_note: Interchange patches at the FINAL (pre-answer) token position, not the mid-sentence recipient-name position used for exploratory position-finding. Empirically validated before running: oracle (full-space) interchange scored 0/8 at the recipient-name position and 6/8 at the final position, with the same 4-layer set. This is a genuine methodological finding, not a free parameter tuned on this run's results -- it was fixed before generating the 32 held-out items scored below.

controls.random_donor: full derangement pairing every receiver with a different item's donor
controls.same_answer: donor and receiver reach the same Z via different reasoning paths and different names/objects

limitations: Development-only diagnostic; not a confirmatory test.
Single model, single task, single rank, single layer set.
learned_causal is fit on only 8 training examples and may be undertrained.

IIA measures whether the top-1 token flips to the donor's answer; it does not yet test secondary probes (original holder, transfer count) or lexical/structural generalization -- those are the next milestones, not yet implemented.
